设 \(Z_i=\frac{X_i}{\sigma}\sim N(0,1)\)，则

\[
U=\sum_{i=1}^6 Z_i^2\sim \chi^2(6),\qquad 
V=\sum_{j=1}^6 Z_{j+6}^2\sim \chi^2(6)
\]

且 \(U,V\) 独立。因此

\[
Y=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^6X_i^2}{\sum_{j=1}^6X_{j+6}^2}
=\frac{\sigma^2 U}{\sigma^2 V}
=\frac{U}{V}\sim F(6,6)
\]

答案：D
